data.narrative:
Icarus is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Henry Kwan, whose background includes spacecraft and space robotics development at Orbital, a $935M NASA space habitat contract win, and prior experience as a NASA flight sciences drone designer with an M.S. in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech and TS/SCI clearance. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies supplemented by reference to a broader Defense & Security comp universe of 2 public equities and 8 additional private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median analysis across the three direct comparables—UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M)—yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This represents the sole triangulation method applicable given available data. The peer-median approach reflects the composition of the private Defense & Security market at early stages, though the spread reflects meaningful variation in stage and underlying business maturity.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. Key uncertainties include Icarus's current revenue or customer traction (not provided), the applicability of later-stage Series A comparables to a Seed-stage company, and the wide dispersion within the peer set. Founder pedigree and government clearance mitigate stage-related risk but require substantiation through revenue or contract pipeline visibility for conviction at the higher end of the range.
